newsitem.title: GERMANY: New German M-DAX future will be commission-free.
newsitem.headline: New German M-DAX future will be commission-free.

text.p: The German bourse said on Monday its new M-DAX future contract, based on the M-DAX index of medium capitalised companies, will be commission-free from its introduction on September 23 until October 31.
After the end of October a charge of 20 pfennigs per contract will be introduced, the bourse said in a statement on Monday.
The bourse also said it will simultaneously introduce 19 new share options on September 23.
The new future contract is geared at marketers trading in German shares and institutional investors, as well as portfolio managers from fund managers and insurance companies, the bourse said.
